verdict.rationale: Fireworks AI is an inference and fine-tuning platform. An in-product feature that analyzes a user's data, such as datasets, usage or deployments, and offers AI-generated insights or suggestions is plausible for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only developer building blocks: model APIs, tool calling, structured outputs and embeddings. It also shows a guided fine-tuning flow and static model-recommendation docs based on internal testing; none of these is an AI-insights feature built on the user's own data inside the product.
